script_text: Halt, Aries! The cosmos is firing a warning shot straight to your core today. Mars, your ruling planet of action and fire, is forming a tense square with Saturn in Aquarius, directly impacting your 11th House of Friendships and Social Networks. This challenging aspect demands you reassess group commitments and set firm boundaries to avoid energy drains. In love, if single, Venus in your 5th House of Romance trines Mars, attracting intense, passionate encounters—focus on creative pursuits to magnetize them. If taken, watch for power struggles as Pluto opposes your 7th House of Partnerships; choose open dialogue over control. Career-wise, this square pressures your 10th House of Public Image, urging meticulous review of deals to prevent setbacks. Financial insight comes through disciplined planning in your 2nd House of Resources. Avoid impulsive arguments in team settings today. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate these potent cosmic currents.
